title: Blood glucose and diabetes
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:58Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank card is written for senior Biology and covers glucagon, glycogen and the full blood glucose feedback loop, which is broader and deeper than this Year 9 point on insulin and diabetes, so a new point is the safer match.

draft.title: Blood glucose and diabetes
card: Glucose is a sugar from food. Cells use it for energy, and it travels around the body in the blood.
After a meal, blood glucose rises. The pancreas releases the hormone insulin, which helps cells take in glucose, so blood glucose falls back.
In diabetes, this system does not work properly. In some people the pancreas makes little or no insulin. In others the cells do not respond well to it. Blood glucose then stays too high.
Some people with diabetes need insulin injections to bring their blood glucose down.
draft.remember: Insulin lowers blood glucose. In diabetes, that control fails.

a.q: Priya eats a large plate of pasta and her blood glucose rises. What does her pancreas do?
opts: Releases insulin so blood glucose falls
Releases insulin so blood glucose rises more
Stops insulin so blood glucose falls
Stops insulin so blood glucose rises more
a.why: Insulin helps cells take in glucose, so blood glucose falls. Releasing insulin would not make glucose rise further. The pancreas responds to the rise by releasing insulin, not by stopping it.
a.clue: Which hormone brings blood glucose down?

b.q: Sam has diabetes and his pancreas makes almost no insulin. Why might insulin injections help him?
opts: They supply the insulin his body lacks
They stop him from absorbing glucose from food
They make his pancreas release more glucose
They replace the glucose his cells need
b.why: Without insulin, cells cannot take in glucose well and blood glucose stays high. Injections supply the missing insulin. They do not replace glucose, because the problem is too much in the blood and not too little.
b.clue: Think about what is missing when the pancreas makes no insulin.

a.best: Releases insulin so blood glucose falls

b.best: They supply the insulin his body lacks
